label: Rst_RT-nitrilase-Tm system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a two-protein Rst_RT-nitrilase-Tm locus represented by DefenseFinder as a two-profile Rst_RT-Tm model requiring Rst_RT-Tm__RT and Rst_RT-Tm__RT-Tm and experimentally linked to AL505_P2 protection when expressed in Escherichia coli.
observations: Rst_RT-nitrilase-Tm branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual RT, RT2, RT-Tm, reverse transcriptase, or nitrilase proteins, DefenseFinder Rst_RT-Tm__RT, Rst_RT-Tm__RT2, and Rst_RT-Tm__RT-Tm HMM profiles, the Rst_RT-nitrilase-Tm article key, the normalized Rst_RT-Tm model namespace, UG5 reverse-transcriptase groups without a complete Rst_RT-nitrilase-Tm locus, unvalidated RefSeq examples, and other Rst, DRT, or Abi reverse-transcriptase-containing phage-defense systems.
